environment: Codex in-app browser; locally served static documentation on 127.0.0.1:4321
method: UI actions and accessibility/DOM observations through CUA; console inspection through the tab developer log API

observations.result: Initial smoke found stale RackMember snapshot use: Play changed to Pause but the readout stayed at 0.0s. Fixed source and added a regression, then reran the full check and rebuilt the site.

Final build: Play changed to Pause and the readout advanced to 0.2s. A subsequent pause showed Play, 0.4s and width: 7.44444% on the progress fill. Mute toggled its data-on state. No captured warning/error logs during the checked actions.
Advance beat changed the readout from beat 0 / 0 to beat 1 / 8. No captured warning/error logs.

Mounted a 4.80s score; Play advanced the readout and emitted cursor, timeupdate and noteOn feedback. Setting tempo to 80 recreated a stopped player at 0.00s with duration 6.00s. Navigation back from the API page mounted the default 4.80s player. No captured warning/error logs.

Scrolling the offline-render sandbox into view mounted one CodeMirror editor with data-api-sandbox-state initialized. Preview remained false; dependency keys contained only @webmusic/score. The offscreen sandbox remained unmounted. No captured warning/error logs.

limits: No microphone or MIDI permission/device test
No timing accuracy, background throttling, cross-browser or full accessibility acceptance
cleanup: Agent-created browser tab closed and temporary localhost server stopped.
